# Topology capture for a DGX Spark: 1x NVIDIA GB10 (sm_121, unified memory, NVLink-C2C to
# the Grace CPU) and the ConnectX-7 exposing four RoCE functions on two PCI domains.

# and "\\" a backslash) or "<path><TAB>-> <target>" for a symbolic link; "#" starts a comment.

# topology answers and inventory replayed by the unit tests).

# replaces any line the real host shows differently.
